nom: Drunk Elephant Amino Rain Glasswater Serum

segments.dry: Multiple reviewers with dry (including very dry, mature-dry) skin report strong hydration and a soft, plumped feel, with several calling it their best solution for persistent dryness and flakiness.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive skin generally report no irritation and good tolerance, including one describing relief for redness/rosacea, though one reviewer with unspecified sensitivity noted redness after use.
segments.combination: Combination-skin reviewers are split: some say the serum controls oiliness and doesn't aggravate breakouts, while one reports the product simply didn't work for her combination skin.
segments.mature: Reviewers in their 60s describe visible anti-aging benefits, sustained hydration, and a younger-looking glow, with one calling it essential for dry, aging skin.
segments.normal: One reviewer describes it as generally suited to normal to dry or combination skin, citing hydration and a radiant finish.

concerns.aging: Several mature reviewers report a firmer, plumper, more youthful-looking glow with continued use; no reviewer reports a negative effect on aging skin specifically.
concerns.dehydration: The large majority of reviewers, across skin types, report immediate and lasting hydration, plumpness, and a dewy 'glass skin' finish without heaviness or greasiness.
concerns.redness: One reviewer reports the serum visibly calmed redness and rosacea-like symptoms and strengthened her barrier; a different reviewer reports the opposite, experiencing new redness after application.
concerns.barrier: A few reviewers credit the serum with supporting or strengthening the skin barrier and improving resilience; no negative barrier reports appear.
concerns.spots: One combination, acne-prone reviewer reports smoother, more even-looking skin after two weeks with no new spots.
concerns.blemishes: Two acne-prone reviewers report no increased breakouts or irritation from the product; no reviewer reports new blemishes caused by it.
concerns.oiliness: Combination and oily-leaning reviewers consistently report no greasy or shiny after-feel, with the product described as lightweight and non-oily even with visible glow.

extraits.texte: I received this complimentary from drunkelephant for my honest review. I found this product to go on light. I followed the instructions that included one pump for application. However, I found that i was experiencing redness after application. There appears to be glitter or something in the formula. Product did not work for my combination skin. I would not recommend this product.

extraits.titre: Love the texture for 66 y/o sentive skin
extraits.texte: Mix it with Propini in the morning, and mix it with Marula oil. Love the texture for my 66 y/or sensitive skin.

extraits.titre: The ingredients are stellar for good skin care!
extraits.texte: I use several drunk elephant products over five years or so now after changing from another brand since my skin is older in my late 60s, but I have good skin, but it's dry, very dry now. I know what to look for in the ingredient deck on a package. Online and I know that the ingredients in this are exceptional for anti-aging! I took a chance on this because it was less expensive than something that was almost $200 that did not have the ingredients this has in it I'm very impressed as it has long-term effects as well. I always apply anything with hyaluronic acid a cover of moisturizer. this is a very serum that will sink right into your skin. It will not leave any kind of texture tackiness or anything like that. Seal it in with a moisturizer is very important with any kind of hyaluronic acid product although this has glutamic acid in it that makes it supreme. I'm so impressed. I bought one as a back up when there was a sale during the holiday this year. I will not be going back to the near $200 bottle. It's ridiculous! My skin feels wonderful with this and it actually leaves it very smooth with a glass like texture. It's hard to explain because of it not being sticky and heavy, I really like that because I use a heavy moisturizer by drunk elephant, actually two of them and they two are absolutely chalk full of wonderful skincare ingredients that protect our skin barrier thank you drunk elephant for your wonderful products that have kept my skin looking young… young younger than
Literally idk how but it like works as a treatment for redness like rosacea for me & helped my barrier be stronger! genuinely love the glow, not shimmery, forever re buy!

This glasswater serum is game changer! I can immediately tell the difference in my skin in terms of moisture and hydration, it's lightweight and has a non-greasy feel. It leaves my skin glowy and brightened! I love using this in the morning to wake up my skin, as someone who's acne prone this doesn't cause any skin irritation or increased acne so it's great for sensitive skin! Complimentary from drunkelephant.

This serum has been a win for me for daytime use under my makeup. The opalescent color of the serum brightens my face instantly and gives it the most natural glow without looking greasy. I have to be really careful with what I put on my face because my combination skin tends to get oily and this serum does not make it oily at all. I like the fermented poly amino acid ingredient because my skin has done well with fermented ingredients in the past. It is too soon to see firming effects but I will look forward to seeing if there is a difference in the future. You can of course use this at night but I love the benefits of using it during the day. Gifted by drunkelephant.

Gifted by Drunk Elephant. I have combination, acne-prone skin, so I have to be very careful with what I use on my skin. Drink Elephant has always been a big winner for me, and the Amino Rain Glasswater Serum does not disappoint. There is a glittery shimmer in the formula that I really like. It leaves my skin looking younger and with a healthy glow. I've been using the serum for about two weeks, and my skin feels smoother and looks less uneven. Loving the texture of this product. Lightweight and never leaving my skin oily or dry.
